commands:
set -euo pipefail
echo '=== REMOTE MAIN VS DEVELOP ==='
printf 'counts origin/main...origin/develop: ' && git rev-list --left-right --count origin/main...origin/develop
printf 'merge-base: ' && git merge-base origin/main origin/develop
echo
echo '--- commits only on origin/main ---'
git log --oneline --decorate --no-merges origin/develop..origin/main
echo
echo '--- commits only on origin/develop ---'
git log --oneline --decorate --no-merges origin/main..origin/develop
echo
echo '--- patch equivalence: git cherry origin/main origin/develop ---'
git cherry origin/main origin/develop || true
echo
echo '--- patch equivalence: git cherry origin/develop origin/main ---'
git cherry origin/develop origin/main || true
echo
echo '--- diff stat origin/main..origin/develop ---'
git diff --stat origin/main..origin/develop
echo
echo '--- changed files origin/main..origin/develop ---'
git diff --name-status origin/main..origin/develop
